title: A Midsummer Night's Dream Has A Bottom Who's Tops

contact_edits.before: Leon Rubin's production, set in a rainforest with trailing tendrils, has no detectible overall vision: Its considerable pleasures have to be taken as they come. Among them are young lovers who hold attention from first to last; an Oberon (Jonathan Goad) in deft control of every mood and nuance; and a superb Bottom (Thom Marriott) who leads an exceptionally funny Pyramus-and-Thisbe show. But cutting references to Athens and the tradesmen severs the play from its roots. Runs until Oct. 31. (Festival Theatre, Stratford, Ontario. 1-800-567-1600.)
